groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code
groups.description: Optional managed-script connector, running scripts through a generic executor per language.

groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local
groups.description: Settings of the trusted-development-only local provider.

groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws
groups.description: Settings of the AWS Lambda provider.

groups.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp
groups.description: Settings of the Google Cloud Run functions provider.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.enabled
properties.description: Whether to serve the 'io.camunda:managed-script:1' job type with the managed-script connector.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provider
properties.description: Name of the managed-code provider bean to use. Built in: 'local', the executor wrapper run in local Node.js or Python processes, for trusted development only; 'aws', one AWS Lambda executor per language; 'gcp', one Google Cloud Run function executor per language.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.deployment-name-prefix
properties.description: Prefix of every provider resource name, one per cluster. The identity of the runtime may only manage resources whose name starts with it. A lowercase letter followed by at most 47 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. In a shared account, use prefixes of one fixed length, such as 'ce-' followed by 24 hexadecimal characters and '-'.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.execution-timeout
properties.description: Maximum duration of one script invocation.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provisioning-timeout
properties.description: How long a job waits for the executors of the cluster, which the runtime creates when it starts. When exceeded, the job fails without consuming a retry and the executors keep being created in the background.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.provisioning-retry-backoff
properties.description: Retry backoff of jobs that failed while waiting for the executors or with a retryable error, and first backoff between attempts to create the executors.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.local.directory
properties.description: Directory of the local provider: the executor wrappers, and a temporary directory per call. Defaults to 'camunda-managed-code' in the Java temporary directory.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.region
properties.description: AWS region of the Lambda executors. Defaults to the region of the default AWS configuration.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.execution-role-arn
properties.description: IAM role attached to every executor. It runs customer code and must grant nothing beyond writing its logs.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.memory-mb
properties.description: Memory of each executor, in MB.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.log-retention-days
properties.description: Retention of the log group the provider creates for each executor, one of the values CloudWatch Logs accepts.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.aws.poll-interval
properties.description: Interval between status reads while an executor is created.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.project
properties.description: Project of the executors. Required for the 'gcp' provider.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.region
properties.description: Region of the executors. Required for the 'gcp' provider.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.function-service-account
properties.description: Service account the executors run as; it must grant nothing. Required, since the platform would otherwise use the default Compute Engine service account, which often has Editor on the project.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.deployer-service-account
properties.description: Service account the runtime impersonates to manage and invoke its executors. When absent, the application default credentials are used as they are and must be able to mint ID tokens.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.memory-mb
properties.description: Memory of each executor, in MiB.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.max-instance-count
properties.description: Maximum instances of each executor, so the maximum parallel scripts of the cluster per language; function code cannot change it.

properties.name: camunda.connector.managed-code.gcp.poll-interval
properties.description: Interval between status reads while an executor is created, with jitter.
